subject: Request: post-report endorsement for SOC 2 gap (Feb–Aug 2026)
messages:
From: Alex Novak <alex.novak@crestwave.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@crestwave.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coverage confirmation request after SOC 2 report

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick onboarding session last week. Procurement is preparing Crestwave's vendor pack and we noticed Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covers the period ending 2026-02-28. Our standard review requires evidence that there haven't been material control changes since the report end date through contract execution.

Can Redwood provide either: 1) a post-report endorsement/bridge letter that confirms no material changes to the scope/controls since 2026-02-28, or 2) documentation of compensating controls for any changes? We expect this for our risk committee by 08/27.

Appreciate a confirmation of timeline and any templates you prefer.

Best,
Alex Novak
Director, Vendor Risk
Crestwave Inc.

--
Attachment: (none)

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for outlining the timeline. We can provide a signed post-report endorsement (commonly called a bridge letter) that affirms no material control degradation since the report period ended on 2026-02-28, or an attestation describing any limited scope changes.

Looping in Rachel (Compliance) and Vivek (Security) to prepare the endorsement and confirm signatures. Quick answers to your questions:
- Target: we can deliver a draft by 2026-08-24 and final signed letter by 2026-08-26.
- Format: PDF signed by our Head of Compliance; if you require notarization / legal wording we can run it past Legal.

Rachel/Vivek — can you take point on drafting the endorsement? Please also confirm whether Legal review is required for wording that includes our limited operational changes since Feb.

Alex — I attached our published SOC 2 Type II report to speed review.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1-415-555-0192

To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, Alex Novak <alex.novak@crestwave.com>, procurement@crestwave.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: DRAFT: post-report endorsement for Crestwave (SOC 2 period end 2026-02-28)

Alex / team — attached is a draft endorsement that summarizes:
- Scope and date of the authoritative SOC 2 report (Period end: 2026-02-28)
- Interim controls and monitoring we maintain post-report (weekly infra change review, continuous vulnerability scanning, quarterly control self-assessments)
- Statement that, to the best of our knowledge and after reasonable inquiry, there have been no material changes to the control environment affecting the report scope through 2026-08-23.

Please review the draft and let me know if Crestwave needs additional language (e.g., explicit callouts for data residency, encryption key management). We redlined two small items as options: "limited scope change disclosure" vs "affirmative no material changes." Choosing the latter shortens your vendor review.

Olga — tagging for quick legal review on the final sentence that references "reasonable inquiry." If Legal requests edits, please flag by EOD 8/24 so we can sign by 8/26.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com

Attachments: bridge_endorsement_draft_20260824.docx
